commands: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_runtime_coverage.py -v; included in canonical host/CI entry
bash tests/run-integration-docker.sh upstream; bash tests/run-integration-docker.sh dya
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/integration -p test_*.py -v (inside the Linux build image)
Explicit offline integration: tests/integration/run.sh; see tests/README.md for pinned workspaces, variant selection and fresh outputs
bash tests/review-shared-hid/run.sh RESOLVED_WORKSPACE FRESH_OUTPUT (both pinned cores, three repeats)
preserved_assertions: All existing arithmetic/driver/kernel/HID and 13 guard assertions retained; actual source config/state types replace copied layouts. DYA selects pinned settings archive admission and NVS reload fixtures.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.
execution.coverage: Each gated real function range requires measured executable lines. Actual-entry recording-tool controls reject empty/unrelated/partial reports; normal full runs retain measured coverage and all existing behavioral assertions.
execution.ci: Both supported-core integration variants, digest-pinned image, fresh retained results even on failure; online branch resolution and exact offline pins are distinct

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.

backends.supported: CONFIG_INPUT_MODE_THREAD; default on both supported cores
backends.unsupported: Synchronous input is rejected by the build guard; direct HID writers outside the input thread are not serialized

suppression_scope: No source-button/final-frame policy. Retain scheduled motion token admission, first-axis cancellation and input-thread HID serialization; final source filter is not a global output interceptor.
runtime_settings: Public runtime API, actual-source adapter, all100 percentage round trips and coupled thresholds; real kernel settings cancellation plus DYA registry/NVS reload; tests/README.md
